name: Patel Infinity Widgets for Elementor
author: Dharmik Patel

sections.description:
Patel Infinity Widgets for Elementor helps you build modern WordPress and WooCommerce layouts with creative widgets, product filters, interactive elements, scrolling text marquees, and responsive controls.

Live Demo: View Live Demo

Features:
– Pi Product Filter widget
– Product Category Filter
– Brand Filter
– Size Filter
– Availability Filter
– Price Min/Max section inside Pi Product Filter
– Range slider
– Min/Max price inputs
– Currency symbol control
– Price step control
– Auto price detection from WooCommerce product prices
– Product query filtering by price
– Product Sorting
– Product Result Count
– Multiple Filter Selection
– Dynamic Filtering
– Responsive Controls
– Pi Marquee Text widget
– Multiple marquee text items
– Separate link per marquee item
– Horizontal and vertical marquee layouts
– Left, right, up, and down marquee directions
– Pause on hover and pause on focus/click
– Edge fade mask
– SVG/image icon upload support
– Icon, text, spacing, padding, border, shadow, and hover style controls
– SEO-friendly linked marquee item output
– Pi Testimonial Marquee widget
– 5 testimonial design styles
– Card presets including Classic, Modern, Glassmorphism, Minimal, Corporate, and Dark
– Scrolling testimonial marquee with left, right, up, and down directions
– Avatar, rating, author name, role, company logo, and per-item link support
– Show/hide controls for profile image, logo, name, designation, company, rating, quote icon, text, divider, border, and shadow
– Profile image, company logo, rating, and quote icon position controls
– Rating display styles: stars, number, or stars with number
– Card link behavior: entire card, name only, or disabled
– Pause on hover, pause on click/focus, edge fade, reverse animation, duplicate items, spacing, typography, border, and shadow controls
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Patel Infinity Widgets for Elementor.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  5. Install and activate WooCommerce if you want to use WooCommerce product filter widgets.
  6. Open any page or template with the Elementor editor.
  7. Search for Pi widgets in the Elementor widget panel.
  8. Drag, customize, and publish your layout.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor is required to use the widgets.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is optional. It is only required for WooCommerce product filter, sorting, and result count widgets.

Can I add links to marquee text items?

Yes. Each Pi Marquee Text item supports its own separate link.

Can I create testimonial marquee sections?

Yes. Pi Testimonial Marquee includes multiple design styles, ratings, avatars, author details, item links, and smooth marquee directions.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Restored the proven Product Filter interface and behavior from version 1.1.1.
  • Added and polished Google Review and branded testimonial layouts.
  • Improved testimonial card spacing, typography, and responsive presentation.
  • Fixed minor UI and compatibility issues.

1.1.4

  • Added Pi Testimonial Marquee widget with 5 design styles.
  • Added advanced testimonial display, position, rating, card preset, and marquee controls.

1.1.3

  • Improved AJAX product filtering without full page reload.
  • Improved Product Result Count refresh behavior.
  • Added mobile filter drawer improvements.
  • Added smooth AJAX loading transitions.
  • Improved Product Sort dropdown, labels, and grid/list switch.
  • Improved widget icons, control grouping, multilingual strings, and performance asset loading.

1.1.2

  • Fixed Pi Marquee Text escaping, vertical preview behavior, icon spacing, Elementor link controls, and Plugin Check warnings.
  • Added Pi Marquee Text widget with multiple items, per-item links, Elementor Icon Library support, SVG/image icon upload, Dynamic Tags link support, left/right/up/down directions, pause controls, edge fade, spacing controls, and modern #242424 black/white styling options.
  • Improved the Price Filter UI with modern Min/Max inputs, reset controls, and refined range slider styling.
  • Disabled the Price Filter by default for existing and new Product Filter widgets.

1.1.1

  • Added cache support for automatic price range detection.
  • Added WordPress.org Plugin Check-safe inline documentation for required WooCommerce price queries.
  • Improved compatibility when WooCommerce is not installed or inactive.
  • Hotfix: Prevent fatal error when WooCommerce is not installed or inactive.

1.1.0

  • Renamed Product Filter widget title to Pi Product Filter.
  • Added Price Filter section inside Pi Product Filter only; no new widget added.
  • Added auto detected min/max WooCommerce product prices.
  • Added range slider, min/max inputs, currency symbol, and step control.
  • Added product query filtering by pi_min_price and pi_max_price.
  • Updated Clear All and result count support for price filters.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
